The '''Pkihantri system''' was situated in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA" /> and hosted the location known as [[Pkihantri]].<ref name="Galladinium" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the latter was the site of a [[Pkihantri Rebel base|Rebel Alliance base]], which the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at one point [[Attack on Pkihantri Rebel base|attacked]].<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pkihantri [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-12.<ref name="TEA" />
